glance: Stocks slide on hot inflation and new tariff plans: Nasdaq down about 3%, S&P 500 down about 2% late morning; Nvidia off nearly 8%.
Core PCE inflation ran 3.3% in October, above forecasts, cementing bets on a December Fed rate hike; Q3 GDP was revised up to 4.3%.
The administration proposed new tariffs of up to 20% on China, the EU and 12 other trading partners, likely not before January.
Trump says a pardon for Jensen Huang is an option but probably unnecessary; Huang testifies to Congress next week.
Markets close Thursday for Thanksgiving and reopen Friday for a half-day session.

tech.headline: Chip rout deepens; Nasdaq-100 nears bear-market territory
tech.summary: Nvidia fell nearly 8% by late morning and the Philadelphia semiconductor index dropped more than 6%, extending a selloff driven by doubts about AI profitability and overspending. A hotter-than-expected inflation reading and new tariff plans piled on, leaving the Nasdaq-100 on pace to close 20% below its peak. Memory makers Micron and Sandisk were among the hardest hit.

tech.headline: Huang apologizes to Nvidia staff as questions mount over his return
tech.summary: In his first all-hands since being reinstated as CEO, Jensen Huang apologized to employees and denied that President Trump forced the board to bring him back. On Wednesday Trump said a pardon for Huang was always an option but likely not needed. Huang is due to testify before Congress next week, and governance experts warn the reinstatement could invite shareholder suits.

tech.headline: Tesla and SpaceX reportedly open formal merger talks
tech.summary: The Financial Times reports the two Musk-led companies have set up special committees of independent directors to negotiate an all-stock combination valuing the pair around $3.5 trillion. It would be among the largest corporate deals ever and would fold Musk's rocket, satellite and AI businesses together with the carmaker.

tech.headline: Dell's AI server boom delivers a record quarter
tech.summary: Dell's quarterly revenue roughly doubled from a year ago to $54.9 billion, and it raised its full-year outlook to $202 billion, with a record $132.3 billion AI server backlog. Despite the blowout, the stock slipped Wednesday as the broader AI selloff overwhelmed the good news.

tech.headline: Anthropic closes below its IPO price
tech.summary: Anthropic shares ended Tuesday at $81.91, under their $83 offering price, as the post-debut rally unwound. Filings also showed co-founders Dario and Daniela Amodei each sold more than $280 million in stock to the IPO underwriters.

tech.headline: Amazon says an AI agent found and exploited a zero-day largely on its own
tech.summary: Amazon reported that an open-source AI agent exploited a previously unknown software vulnerability with only limited human help. It is a notable real-world sign that autonomous AI tools can speed up offensive hacking, raising pressure on defenders to patch faster.

tech.headline: Huawei convicted on trade-secret and bank-fraud charges
tech.summary: A US federal jury found Huawei guilty of conspiring to steal trade secrets and of bank fraud, while acquitting it on the racketeering conspiracy count. The verdict caps a long-running case at the center of US-China tech tensions.

markets.summary: Stocks are sharply lower as a hot core PCE reading locks in a likely December Fed hike, new tariff proposals rattle investors, and the AI-chip selloff deepens; Treasuries are rallying.

movers.name: Nvidia
movers.note: AI profitability doubts; second straight losing session

movers.name: Micron
movers.note: Among the biggest losers in the chip selloff

movers.name: Dell Technologies
movers.note: Lower despite record quarter and raised forecast

other.headline: Inflation heats up as economy grows faster than thought
other.summary: October's PCE price index rose 3.8% from a year earlier, the highest since 2023, while core prices rose 3.3%, a tenth above forecasts. Separately, third-quarter GDP growth was revised up to a 4.3% annual rate. Futures now price roughly a 98% chance of a quarter-point Fed hike in December.

other.headline: Administration proposes new tariffs on 14 trading partners
other.summary: Following an eight-month probe into excess factory capacity, the US proposed duties of up to 20% on China, the EU and 12 other partners, stacked on existing tariffs. Officials say they would take effect after hearings and public comment, likely January at the earliest; the US-China trade truce expires Jan. 10.

other.headline: Iran vows to confront the US naval blockade
other.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry said it will use every available tool against the US naval blockade reinstated in July, keeping Gulf tensions and oil prices in focus.

other.headline: Israeli strike kills Hamas security chief in Gaza
other.summary: Israeli airstrikes killed Hamas internal security director Naeem Abu Nahel and six others, including two police officers, according to Gaza medics and police.

other.headline: Trump to order faster federal death-penalty cases
other.summary: President Trump said he will sign a directive telling the Justice Department to speed up federal executions and seek the death penalty in certain murder cases.

other.headline: Rep. Jimmy Gomez to resign after ethics finding
other.summary: The California Democrat said he will step down next week after the House Ethics Committee found he violated rules on sexual conduct toward employees.
